estimate: About 200 hours, difficulty about 4/10: long, not hard. One playthrough is enough; all 55 trophies are single-player and there are no online or difficulty trophies. Sources: KeenGamer and OutputLag.

stages.name: Play the story — Chapters 1 to 5
steps: Play the story through. No mission medals are needed, so enjoy the campaign; story trophies pop as you go.
Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter and one from just before the final mission. There is no mission replay and no New Game Plus — 15 manual save slots are your safety net.

In Chapter 1, do Lucia's balcony meditation: after the mission Down to Earth, when she mentions meditating in the morning at Jason's house, follow her to the balcony and accept. It is the one interaction that can be missed, and it feeds Positive Mental Attitude.
Start the side-story strands (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret) when they appear; their finales stay open after the story, but starting them early spreads the work out.
Do the Chapter 3 race against Yago the moment it appears — it is time-sensitive (hourglass icon) and its strand counts toward Strangers & Freaks. Save first, then race.

stages.name: Along the way — scan, study, try everything
steps: Scan vehicles and landmarks with the WAiNK app from the start — it feeds both You WAiNKer! (100 locations) and Whip It Good (100 vehicles discovered).
Study wildlife through binoculars whenever you meet a new species — the 100% checklist wants 100 animals studied.
Try each of the nine activity types once for Master of None: races, fishing, arcade games, shooting ranges, drone races and the rest.
Never use cheats on your trophy save — cheats switch off trophies and saving while active.

stages.name: After the credits — 100% completion
steps: Open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion to see what is left. Work done before the story ended already counts.
Finish the robbery numbers first — they also pay for the garages and gear the other trophies need.
Then the collectibles and activities below. Do not collect everything: the checklist asks for set portions of most things, and you can stop each activity once its number is met.
This stage earns A Long Road (gold) and, on the way, Cunning Stunts, The Shootist, Top Fun, Don't Touch My Deck, You WAiNKer!, Whip It Good, Maximum Withdrawal, Dime on the Dollar and One Last Thing.

stages.name: Cleanup — Strangers, finales and odd jobs
steps: Finish the eight qualifying Strangers & Freaks strands (Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's strands have their own trophies and do not count).
Complete the final missions for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone if any are left.
Finish the remaining meditation spots for Positive Mental Attitude.
Earn any outstanding combat, driving, robbery or miscellaneous trophies, then check the list — Vice Got a Price! pops with the last one.

title: Roadmap to the Platinum — Vice Got a Price!
